newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Huafa '96 net hits 38 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Huafa '96 net hits 38 mln yuan.

text.p: Shenzhen Huafa Electronics Co Ltd reaped net profits of 38.42 million yuan for the year ended December 31, 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Monday.
Earnings per share were 0.18 yuan and turnover reached 268.61 million yuan in 1996, the exchange said.
It did not reveal whether the figures were based on Chinese or international accounting standards or give comparative figures.
In 1995, the company posted net profits of 41.08 million yuan under international standards.
The company proposed a cash payment of 0.14 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, and a two-for-10 bonus share issue based on capital surplus, the exchange said.
Trading in Huafa's A and B shares will be suspended on Tuesday morning and will resume in the afternoon, the exchange said.
